page0.text:
"Ugh..."
I stop.
I make it out of the church, but my body tells me it's reached its limit.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page0:1

page1.text:
"Shirou. Let us rest here. Your body will not last like this."
"Ngh...yeah... I hate that I'm causing you so much trouble..."
I lean away from Saber's shoulders and sit on the grass.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page1:1

page2.text:
"Nnngh."
My chest wound is still there.
It's stopped bleeding, but there's still a gaping hole in my chest.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page2:1

page3.text:
"I feel...sick..."
The pain might be gone, but I've still got a hole right through me.
Just looking at it makes me sick to my stomach. More than that, I can't believe I'm still alive.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page3:1

page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page4:1

page5.text:
"Oh...uh...okay..."
"Please excuse me. It may hurt a bit, but please bear with me."
Saber's fingers trail over my chest.
And then...
I don't know what she's thinking, but Saber places her hand on my chest and lets it sink into my body!
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page5:1

page6.text:
"Ah...agggh!"
My entire body jerks and bucks in response.
Saber's hand is relentless, moving around inside me...
"Idio—what are you!?"
She's touching my organs with her bare hands!!!
How could that not be blindingly painful?
It should hurt, but...
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page6:1

page7.text:
"Huh...?"
There's absolutely no pain.
In fact, everywhere Saber touches, it feels like the pain is fading...
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page7:1

page8.text:
"I am done, Shirou. I have replenished the sheath's magical energy. Your wound should heal in half a day."
She draws her hand from my chest, looking relieved.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page8:1

page9.text:
"Sheath?"
I have no idea what she's talking about.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page9:1

page10.text: "Saber, what do you mean by sheath? You mentioned it before...but, are you talking about your sheath?"
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page10:1

page11.text:
Saber's sheath.
It has to be Excalibur's sheath.
Invisible Air isn't her sheath.
The legendary sheath of Excalibur is a Noble Phantasm that makes its possessor immortal.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page11:1

page12.text:
But she doesn't have it.
King Arthur died in the Battle of Camlann because that sheath was lost.
So there's no way Saber has Excalibur's sheath right now...
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page12:1

page13.text:
"Yes. My sheath is inside your body. Not realizing that until last night is my failure."
"Inside...me? That sounds kind of absurd."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page13:1

page14.text: "Do you really think so? It is actually quite simple, really. You summoned me. It was foolish to think that you were able to do that by sheer coincidence."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page14:1

page15.text:
"To summon a Heroic Spirit, one must possess a symbol that has some connection to that Heroic Spirit. As you had no knowledge of being Master, nor any experience as a mage, you must have had some sort of connection to me.
That is where my sheath...the lost sheath of Excalibur...comes in."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page15:1

page16.text:
"Uh...well, that might be true, but...
But why is something like that inside me?"
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page16:1

page17.text:
"I expect that was Kiritsugu's doing.
In the previous war, Kiritsugu Emiya summoned me using Excalibur's sheath as a catalyst. As the sheath is a Noble Phantasm that heals the possessor's wounds, Kiritsugu must have determined that it would be advantageous to hold on to it rather than return it to me."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page17:1

page18.text:
"I am already able to heal myself, which makes it difficult to kill me.
Allowing the Master, who is more vulnerable, to hold the sheath would increase his chances of winning the war."
"So my old man survived the war pretty much the same way as I've been surviving."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page18:1

page19.text:
"Most likely, yes. And when the war was over and I disappeared...
Kiritsugu was wandering through the fiery ruins and found a dying child. He did not have any healing powers, and it was probably too late anyway.
And so, he saw only one method to save the child."
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page19:1

page20.text:
...
My hand goes to my chest.
On that day ten years ago...
I accepted death as I was looking up at that sky.
My whole body was burned. Maybe I really was little more than cinders.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page20:1

page21.text:
So when Kiritsugu found a kid that was barely alive, he had to rely on the one thing he had with him.
The sacred sword's sheath, said to protect the possessor's life.
By implanting the sheath in me, he saved the child who was on the verge of death.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page21:1

page22.text:
"So you're saying...?"
"Yes. It has been disassembled and lacks its original shape, but your body does contain the sheath. That is the source of your healing abilities."
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page22:1

page23.text:
"B-but...I almost died. When Lancer stabbed me at school, and..."
That's right...
Someone saved me then.
By the time I came to, there was nobody there...just a piece of rock lying next to me.
I felt that was really important, so I brought it home. I wonder if it's still there?
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page23:1

page24.text:
"That is before you and I formed a contract.
The sheath is my Noble Phantasm. Until I manifested and infused it with magical energy, it would not function as a Noble Phantasm. Until you formed a contract with me, you would not have the power of immortality."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page24:1

page25.text: "Though, as long as it has even a little magical energy within it, it may be able to protect the possessor's life. But it would be weak. To save a human being on the verge of death, it must have been necessary to integrate the sheath into your body."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page25:1

page26.text: "I see. Um...sorry, Saber. I feel bad for using your sheath for myself."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page26:1

page27.text:
"What are you talking about? You are my Master; it is quite natural for you to use what is mine.
Besides...I was happy when I learned the truth. Even though I could not save anyone from that disaster, my sheath still saved your life."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page27:1

page28.text:
...
Her smile is so bright, I can't help but look away.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page28:1

page29.text:
"Shirou? Um, does your wound hurt?"
"No, that's not it. It's fine. Don't worry about it. You did nothing wrong!"
I cover my blushing face and fall silent.
...This is so embarrassing.
Not speaking means no pain, but this is really awkward.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page29:1

page30.text:
I'm not sure how much time passed.
Just as I start to calm down...
Saber speaks quietly.
"Kiritsugu was correct. So, he did not betray me."
Her voice is heavy with regret.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page30:1

page31.text:
"Saber?"
"I should never have sought that Holy Grail. No, I never needed the Holy Grail from the beginning. Kiritsugu must have realized that."
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page31:1

page32.text:
It sounds more like a confession.
Saber is making an apology to someone she can't apologize to. Not anymore.
She reflects on herself as a way of saying goodbye to the feelings she held for so long.
Even if she doesn't say it in so many words...
I understand just by being beside her.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page32:1

page33.text:
Altria sought the Holy Grail.
A lonely king who had no choice but to believe that, without the Holy Grail, she could not avoid ruin.
If only...
She'd wished to redo everything from the moment she drew the sword from the stone...
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page33:1

page34.text:
"Saber, that's..."
"I knew all along. I knew I could not just redo everything.
I knew that, but I kept lying to myself."
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page34:1

page35.text:
But that ends here.
Her long battle can now really...
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page35:1

page36.text:
"Thank you, Shirou. With your help, I now know the path I must take.
Yes. The Holy Grail and I are just dreams that should not exist."
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page36:1

page37.text:
But still, she mumbles about wanting to be forgiven.
She should never have wished for what she did...and in all that time, she'd never been able to fulfill it...
The weakness was only a fleeting dream.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page37:1

page38.text:
...
How should I feel right now?
What she says is...beautiful.
Her decision is dignified and proud, just like her.
She takes pride in her past now, and accepts the end that awaits her.
And now Saber has...
She has decided to follow the promise she made until the very end.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page38:1

page39.text:
...
She doesn't even need to tell me what that means.
She will never waver again.
And she is more beautiful than ever.
In the dark of that night...in the moment I met her under the moonlight and admired her appearance...I loved her, from the very beginning.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page39:1

page40.text:
Then...
Regardless of what awaits ahead, there's only one thing to be done.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page40:1

page41.text:
"Saber, let's destroy the Holy Grail."
I cut away any lingering attachment, I banish my selfishness, and say what has to be done.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page41:1

page42.text: "Yes. I knew you would come to that conclusion, Master."
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page42:1

page43.text:
Saber nods reassuringly.
I can't smile back at her right now.
I'm trying my best to suppress my feelings for her and convince myself that this is the right thing to do.
I'm sure that, someday, I'll be proud she trusted me with this decision.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page43:1

page44.text:
...
I stand up.
Now that's settled, we can't just rest here forever.
We know what must be done, and our enemy is clear.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page44:1

page45.text:
No more detours.
Today...we put an end to this battle.
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-22:page45:1
